community.cdd_note: Sarasota National Community Development District. On one verified 2026 TRIM notice from Sarasota National the CDD assessment was $1,497 a year, and the whole non-ad valorem side, including county fire, solid waste and stormwater, was $2,246. That is one parcel, not an average, and the amount varies by phase and bond series.
